enchantments.tooltip: Illusion Focus +3: +3 Equipment bonus to the DC of Illusion spells.
Spell Resistance +13: +13 Enhancement bonus to Spell Resistance.
Spell Save +4: This item gives a +4 Resistance bonus to your saves versus spells.
Jump +9: Passive: +9 Competence bonus to the Jump skill.

Feather Falling: This item is engraved with feathers and bestows a powerful magical effect. Whenever the wearer begins to fall from any height, this effect slows the descent dramatically, causing the wearer to fall like a feather.
Mythic Cloak Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
